title: Construction of the Sun Temple
description: The Sun Temple was built in the 13th century during the reign of Narasimha Deva I of the Ganga dynasty.

title: Loss of the Vimana Shikhara
description: The high tower and shikhara of the Vimana were razed in the 19th century.

title: UNESCO World Heritage Inscription
description: Sun Temple, Konârak was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List under criteria (i), (iii) and (vi).

title: Foundation Subsidence
description: UNESCO recorded serious subsidence of the sand-fill and surrounding foundation supporting the large stone structure following heavy monsoon rains.

title: Structural Study and Emergency Assistance
description: UNESCO requested structural studies concerning the conservation and structural condition of the monument with World Heritage Fund Emergency Assistance.

source.title: State of Conservation records for Sun Temple, Konârak

title: Approx. 2-Ton Stone Fall
description: A stone weighing approximately 2 tons reportedly fell from the north-east side of the Jagamohan porch onto the Pidha ledge.

title: Serious Concern Over Continued Deterioration
description: UNESCO expressed serious concern over the state of conservation and requested urgent measures to halt deterioration of the stone structures.

title: ICOMOS Reactive Monitoring Mission
description: An ICOMOS expert undertook a reactive monitoring mission to examine the state of conservation and review work associated with the World Heritage Fund Emergency Assistance.

title: No Immediate Structural Threat Found
description: The ICOMOS mission found no immediate threat to the monument from structural instability. Long-term effects of loosening stone parts and water penetration required further examination.

title: Cyclone Damage to Green Belt
description: A recent cyclone had extensively damaged the site's green belt, which served as a buffer and screen against possible salt infiltration from the sea breeze.

title: Regular Maintenance and Periodic Monitoring
description: UNESCO encouraged continuation of the regular maintenance programme and periodic submission of monitoring reports on the state of conservation.

title: Jagamohana Conservation and Stabilisation
description: The 2003 UNESCO periodic report recorded major conservation and restoration works on the Jagamohana platform and reported the property as stabilised.

title: Periodic Conservation and Management Reporting
description: UNESCO's second periodic reporting cycle documented conservation, management, scientific studies and monitoring information for the property.

title: Minor Boundary Modification Examination
description: UNESCO examined the proposed minor boundary modification for Sun Temple, Konârak.

title: ASI Conservation Measures
description: ASI reported measures addressing saline action, water logging, erosion and vegetative intrusion, including surface cleaning, stone consolidation and strengthening, tree plantation, pumping sets and periodic biocidal treatment.

source.organization: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
source.title: Conservation of the Sun Temple at Konark

title: Periodic Reporting Cycle 3
description: UNESCO's third periodic reporting cycle documented the property's Outstanding Universal Value, conservation and management context.

title: Current Official Heritage Record
description: The Ministry of Culture's official Sun Temple page remains an active government reference for the monument and was last updated on 03 September 2026.

source.organization: Ministry of Culture, Government of India
